creator.label: FOR CREATORS AND STREAMERS
creator.title: You make the world more interesting.
creator.lead: Build a page where your audience can support you. Donations, goals and OBS alerts alongside your creative work.
creator.strip: CREATORS MAKE THE WORLD MORE INTERESTING
creator.previewText: Support, a goal and stream events in one place.
creator.stepsTitle: From an idea to your first stream

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.text: Your name, description and link help your audience recognize you.

steps.title: Set up support
steps.text: Add a goal and style your OBS alerts. Try everything in test mode.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.text: Your audience chooses when and how to support you.

creator.futureTitle: A useful purchase. Support for you.
creator.futureText: Curate a storefront or enable just a promo code. Codes work across eligible marketplace products; your storefront contains selected products with higher support rates. The buyer pays the ordinary price. Configure it in your studio; payments remain in testing.

faq.a: No. Public pages work for different kinds of creators. OBS tools are only needed for live broadcasts.

faq.q: Can I accept real money yet?
faq.a: Payments in the current local MVP are simulated. Real payments and payouts require provider integration and review.

faq.q: Where do I manage my page?
faq.a: In your dashboard after setting up your profile. The homepage still stays a marketplace.

seller.label: FOR DIGITAL GOODS SELLERS
seller.title: Made something good? Bring it here.
seller.note: from your folder to the world
seller.lead: Digital assets, design, lessons or services. Explain what buyers get, set clear terms and manage orders in one place.
seller.strip: SOMEBODY COULD USE WHAT YOU MADE
seller.previewTitle: From an idea to the catalog
seller.previewText: Description, terms, moderation and a clear order process.

steps.title: Set up your profile
steps.text: Introduce yourself and your work. Buyers want to know who made it.

steps.title: Add your product
steps.text: Set the price, contents, timing and delivery method. Then submit it for moderation.

steps.title: Manage your orders
steps.text: Follow order statuses, meet your terms and deliver through the existing order process.

seller.futureText: Set two support rates from your proceeds: higher for storefronts, lower for promo codes. Price comparisons respect the exact variant. Configure rates in the editor; live payouts require a separate launch.

faq.a: Digital goods and services in the catalog's permitted categories. Products need clear descriptions and terms and go through moderation.

faq.q: How do buyers receive their order?
faq.a: The listing specifies delivery: digital file, manual delivery or a session. Explain your terms and timing in advance.
The local MVP currently uses test payments. Real payments and payouts are separate launch stages following provider review.

shared.roleFooter: At your own pace. No promises of easy money.
